name_ru: Зеркало Януса — R3775 независимые эпохи и сопоставимые контрольные поля
research_question: Does an independently measured infrared or optical source around the arbitrary 3775th sky coordinate show repeatable properties beyond comparable nearby control fields?

origin.construction: SHA256 arbitrary direction and its equatorial mirror, not a physical prediction

preselected_allwise_neighbor.warning: Selected after seeing catalog. No physical identity to direction 3775 and W3/W4 photometric values without quality flags are not validated detections.

field_controls.approximation: tangent-plane local offsets keeping nearby Galactic latitude and observing conditions; count local source densities with equivalent search radius

source_controls.selection: Deterministic smallest W1/W2/color-distance after rejecting catalog artifacts where flags are available; freeze before NEOWISE observations; require >=8 for empirical comparison

archived_epoch_observations.quality: 0 < mag_err <= 0.35; SNR >=5, reduced chi2 <=3 and no known artifact flags if available. Missing quality fields must be flagged.
archived_epoch_observations.variability: Delta season mean >=0.4 magnitudes and >=5 estimated standard errors, both must hold
archived_epoch_observations.calibration: 12 brightness-matched source controls and 16 matched local sky fields

independent_observations.optical: Pan-STARRS DR2 multi-epoch detections, query fixed RA/Dec, preserve observation time and photometric quality
independent_observations.infrared: WISE and NEOWISE are same instrument family but separate temporal exposures, not two independent instruments
independent_observations.missing_data: UNAVAILABLE is never proof of no source

interpretation.source_association: At 6.66 arcsec offset and without astrometric evidence, AllWISE neighbor cannot automatically be assigned to theoretical sky point
interpretation.novelty: No novel probe or technosignature from catalog neighbors, a rare variable or hash-mapped coordinate. Independent new observations and replication required.
interpretation.R42B: HOLD until authenticated original telescope pointing and external blind data
